functionalRequirement: User shall/will be able to open various types of accounts like savings, fixed deposit, etc.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support at least 5 different account types (savings, fixed deposit, current, recurring deposit, and salary accounts) with all their specific attributes and rules correctly implemented.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires supporting various account types, necessitating complete implementation of all account types mentioned and potentially others.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The account opening process must complete within 3 minutes for any account type under normal system load conditions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient account opening is critical for user satisfaction when creating different types of accounts.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The account opening interface must clearly differentiate between account types with visual cues and explanatory text, with 90% of users able to select the correct account type for their needs in usability testing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users need to understand differences between account types to make appropriate selections.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The account opening functionality must maintain 99.9% availability during banking hours (8 AM to 8 PM) and 99% during non-banking hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Account opening is a critical banking function that requires high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must implement multi-factor authentication for opening new accounts and encrypt all personal and financial information using AES-256 encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Financial account creation requires strong security measures to protect sensitive user information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must allow new account types to be added with configuration changes only, requiring no more than 5 person-days of effort per new account type.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Banking products evolve over time, requiring the system to be easily maintainable for new account types.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support customization of account parameters (interest rates, minimum balances, withdrawal limits) through an administrative interface without requiring code changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Different account types have different parameters that may need adjustment over time.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to add expenses with details including amount, date, payer, and optional split among participants.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The expense tracking system must support at least 5 different splitting methods (equal, percentage, fixed amount, shares, and by items) with 100% accuracy in calculations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR mentions optional split among participants, requiring complete and correct implementation of splitting functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must process and save an expense entry, including complex splits among up to 20 participants, in less than 2 seconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick expense entry is essential for user satisfaction, especially when handling complex splits.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The expense entry interface must allow users to complete a basic expense entry in less than 30 seconds, with split functionality requiring no more than 3 additional steps.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Expense tracking should be quick and intuitive to encourage regular use.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The expense tracking system must maintain data integrity with zero loss of expense entries even during system failures, with automatic recovery mechanisms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Financial data requires high reliability to maintain user trust and accurate records.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must enforce access controls ensuring users can only view and modify expenses they created or are participants in, with all financial data encrypted at rest and in transit.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Expense data may contain sensitive financial information requiring protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The expense tracking module must achieve a cyclomatic complexity score below 15 for all methods and maintain a test coverage of at least 90%.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Complex financial calculations require high maintainability to ensure correctness over time.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support the addition of new expense fields and splitting methods through configuration without requiring code changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Expense tracking requirements may evolve, requiring the system to adapt to new fields and splitting methods.

functionalRequirement: Faculties shall be able to upload and download assignments, college notices, student notices, journals, and videos.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall support all common file formats for assignments (DOC, DOCX, PDF, TXT), notices (PDF, DOCX), journals (PDF), and videos (MP4, AVI, MOV) with 100% format compatibility.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires handling multiple document types, necessitating comprehensive format support for faculty uploads and downloads.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall complete file uploads of up to 100MB in less than 30 seconds and downloads in less than 15 seconds under normal network conditions (minimum 10Mbps connection).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Faculty members need efficient file transfer capabilities to manage educational materials without delays.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall support at least 50 concurrent upload/download operations without degradation in performance.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Multiple faculty members may need to access the system simultaneously, especially during peak periods like exam preparation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The file upload/download interface shall provide clear progress indicators and confirmation messages, with no more than 3 steps required to complete either operation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Faculty members need intuitive interfaces to efficiently manage educational materials without requiring extensive training.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall automatically resume interrupted uploads/downloads when connection is restored, with no more than 5% of data loss requiring retransmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Faculty operations should not be severely impacted by temporary network issues, ensuring reliable file transfers.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall implement role-based access controls ensuring only authorized faculty members can upload official notices and academic materials, with all access attempts logged.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling official academic materials that require proper authorization and accountability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All uploaded and downloaded files shall be scanned for malware with detection rates of at least 99% for known threats.
identifiedNFRs.justification: File exchange functionality creates potential security vulnerabilities that must be mitigated to protect system integrity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The file management system shall be modular, allowing independent updates to upload, download, and storage components without affecting other system functions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The file handling functionality may need updates or enhancements over time without disrupting the entire system.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall be capable of scaling to store up to 5TB of uploaded content with the ability to expand storage capacity by at least 20% annually without service interruption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Educational content will grow over time, requiring scalable storage capabilities to accommodate increasing faculty uploads.

functionalRequirement: System shall allow users to rate and review services by providing comments on tour plans or services, with comments stored in the database and a thank you message displayed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The rating system shall support numerical ratings (1-5 stars) and text reviews of up to 1000 characters, with 100% of submitted content properly stored and displayed.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires complete and accurate capture of user feedback in multiple formats (ratings and comments).

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall process and store ratings and reviews within 2 seconds of submission and display the thank you message within 1 second thereafter.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick response times are essential for a positive user experience when providing feedback.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall handle at least 100 concurrent rating/review submissions without performance degradation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Popular services may receive multiple reviews simultaneously, requiring efficient processing capacity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The rating and review interface shall be intuitive enough that 90% of first-time users can successfully submit feedback without assistance or errors.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The feedback system should be accessible to all users regardless of technical proficiency to maximize participation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The thank you message shall be customized based on the rating provided (positive or negative) and displayed prominently for at least 3 seconds before dismissal.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Acknowledgment of user feedback enhances engagement and encourages future participation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The rating and review system shall maintain 99.9% uptime during business hours and automatically save draft reviews if submission is interrupted.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users should be able to provide feedback reliably without losing their input due to system issues.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall implement CAPTCHA or equivalent verification for anonymous reviews to prevent automated spam, with false positive rate below 1%.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Review systems are vulnerable to spam and abuse, requiring protective measures while maintaining legitimate user access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User review data shall be stored with appropriate access controls ensuring only authorized personnel can access the complete review database.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Review data may contain personal opinions and information requiring protection from unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The rating and review component shall be implemented as a separate module that can be modified or enhanced without affecting other system functions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Feedback mechanisms often require refinement based on usage patterns and business needs.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall support future expansion to include media attachments (photos, videos) in reviews without requiring major architectural changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Feedback systems typically evolve to include richer content types, requiring forward-compatible design.

functionalRequirement: Customers shall be able to search for new products in the database by entering item names, and upon successful search, view detailed product information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The product search functionality shall return relevant results for at least 95% of valid product name queries, including partial matches and common misspellings.
identifiedNFRs.justification: This ensures the search function effectively fulfills its core purpose of finding products based on customer input.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The product search shall return results within 2 seconds for 95% of queries, even during peak loads of up to 1000 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Fast search response is critical for customer satisfaction when searching for products.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The product detail view shall load all information (images, specifications, pricing) within 3 seconds for 90% of requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Customers need timely access to product details after performing a search to make purchase decisions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search interface shall provide auto-suggestions after the user types 3 or more characters, with suggestions appearing within 500ms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Auto-suggestions enhance the search experience by helping customers find products more easily.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The product detail view shall present information in a consistent layout with critical details (price, availability, specifications) visible without scrolling on standard desktop and mobile viewports.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Consistent and accessible presentation of product information improves the customer experience after search.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search functionality shall maintain 99.9% availability during business hours and 99.5% during non-business hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Search is a core customer-facing function that requires high availability to ensure customer satisfaction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search function shall sanitize all user inputs to prevent SQL injection and cross-site scripting attacks, with 100% of inputs validated before processing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Search functionality involves user input that could be exploited if not properly secured.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search functionality shall be implemented as a separate service module with defined APIs, allowing for updates without affecting other system components.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Modular implementation enables easier maintenance and updates to the search functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search system shall be able to scale to handle a 200% increase in product database size without degradation in performance.
identifiedNFRs.justification: As the product catalog grows, the search functionality must maintain its performance levels.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to search for suggested doctors for consultation based on their symptoms or predicted diseases.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The doctor recommendation system shall match users with appropriate specialists with at least 90% relevance based on symptoms or diseases entered.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The core function requires accurate matching between medical conditions and appropriate medical specialists.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The doctor search functionality shall return results within 3 seconds for 95% of queries, even during peak usage periods.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users seeking medical consultation need timely recommendations, especially in potential emergency situations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The doctor search functionality shall be compatible with all major browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and mobile platforms (iOS, Android) with the same level of functionality.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users may need to search for doctors across different devices and platforms, particularly in urgent situations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The symptom input interface shall provide auto-complete suggestions from a standardized medical terminology database after typing 2 or more characters.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Medical terminology can be complex; auto-complete helps users accurately describe their conditions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The doctor recommendation results shall display key information (specialty, experience, availability, location) in a consistent format that requires no more than one click to access detailed profiles.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users need clear, accessible information to make informed decisions about which doctor to consult.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The doctor search system shall maintain 99.95% uptime, with scheduled maintenance only during off-peak hours (2 AM - 4 AM local time).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Medical consultations may be needed at any time, requiring high availability of the search function.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All symptom and disease information entered by users shall be encrypted in transit and at rest using industry-standard encryption (TLS 1.3 and AES-256).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Medical information is highly sensitive personal data requiring strong protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall implement role-based access controls ensuring that only authorized healthcare providers can view detailed user symptom information.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Medical privacy regulations require strict access controls for patient health information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The medical terminology and doctor database shall be updateable without system downtime, with changes reflected in search results within 15 minutes of updates.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Medical information and doctor availability change frequently, requiring easy maintenance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system shall clearly indicate that doctor recommendations are not a substitute for emergency care, with prominent warnings for symptoms that suggest immediate medical attention is required.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Patient safety requires clear guidance about the limitations of the recommendation system in emergency situations.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to choose payment methods such as PayPal balance, debit or credit card, and transfer funds by entering recipient's email ID or name, and making the payment.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support 100% of the specified payment methods (PayPal balance, debit card, credit card) without errors during transaction processing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR explicitly requires multiple payment methods, necessitating complete implementation of all specified options.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The payment processing system must complete transactions within 3 seconds for 95% of payment attempts under normal operating conditions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Payment processing requires efficient time behavior to ensure user satisfaction and prevent abandonment during the payment flow.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The payment interface must clearly indicate all available payment methods with recognizable icons and labels, with 90% of users able to complete a payment transaction on their first attempt without assistance.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR focuses on user choice and payment completion, requiring an intuitive interface for payment method selection and recipient identification.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The payment system must maintain 99.9% uptime during business hours and 99.5% during non-business hours, with no more than 5 minutes of consecutive downtime.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Payment processing is a critical function requiring high availability to ensure users can complete transactions when needed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All payment data must be encrypted using TLS 1.3 during transmission, and credit/debit card information must be tokenized and comply with PCI DSS requirements.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive financial information requiring strong security measures to protect user payment details.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must implement multi-factor authentication for payments exceeding $1000 and maintain an audit log of all payment transactions for at least 2 years.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Financial transactions require accountability and non-repudiation to protect both users and the organization from fraud.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The payment processing module must be implemented as a separate service with well-defined APIs that can be updated independently of other system components.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Payment methods and regulations change frequently, requiring a modular design that supports easy modifications and updates.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The payment system must be designed to incorporate new payment methods with no more than 2 weeks of development effort per new payment method.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies a need for multiple payment methods, suggesting adaptability to add new payment options in the future is important.

functionalRequirement: System shall automatically update the available quantity of each medicine after a sale is completed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The inventory system must accurately update medicine quantities for 100% of completed sales with zero discrepancies between recorded sales and inventory changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires precise tracking of medicine quantities, necessitating complete accuracy in inventory updates.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The inventory update must complete within 500 milliseconds after sale confirmation for 99% of transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Automatic updates should occur promptly to maintain real-time inventory accuracy and prevent potential overselling.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The inventory update mechanism must have a failure rate of less than 0.01%, with automatic retry capabilities for failed updates.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Inventory accuracy is critical for medicine sales, requiring high reliability to prevent stock discrepancies.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Inventory update operations must be restricted to authenticated sales processes and authorized personnel, with all changes logged for audit purposes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Medicine inventory represents valuable assets requiring protection from unauthorized modifications.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The inventory update module must include automated tests that verify correct quantity calculations for at least 95% of possible sales scenarios.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The automatic nature of updates requires high testability to ensure continued correct operation as the system evolves.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The inventory system must support batch updates for bulk sales and returns, handling at least 1,000 items in a single transaction without performance degradation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: While the FR mentions individual sales, the system should scale to accommodate various sales volumes and scenarios.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must implement concurrency controls to prevent race conditions when multiple sales of the same medicine occur simultaneously, ensuring inventory accuracy is maintained.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Medicine inventory requires safe integration with the sales process to prevent critical errors in stock levels that could affect patient care.

functionalRequirement: The system shall provide a calendar view of available appointment slots for each healthcare provider

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The calendar view must display 100% of available appointment slots for each healthcare provider without omission, including all time slots within the provider's working hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Complete representation of all available slots is essential for the calendar view to fulfill its core purpose.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The calendar view must load and display all available appointment slots within 2 seconds, even when displaying data for up to 50 healthcare providers simultaneously.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick loading of the calendar is necessary for a responsive user experience when scheduling appointments.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The calendar interface must use color coding and clear visual indicators to distinguish between available, booked, and unavailable time slots, with a legend explaining these indicators.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Visual differentiation is critical for users to quickly identify available slots in a calendar view.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The calendar must support navigation between days, weeks, and months with no more than 2 clicks or interactions per navigation action.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Easy navigation is essential for users to find available appointment slots across different time periods.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The calendar view must maintain 99.9% accuracy in reflecting real-time availability, with automatic updates at intervals of no more than 30 seconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Real-time accuracy is crucial to prevent double bookings and ensure users see current availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The calendar view must restrict access to provider availability information based on user roles, with authentication required for viewing sensitive scheduling details.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provider schedules may contain sensitive information requiring appropriate access controls.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The calendar component must be implemented as a reusable module that can be updated independently from other system components, with documented APIs for integration.
identifiedNFRs.justification: A modular approach ensures the calendar view can be maintained and enhanced without affecting other system functions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The calendar view must support customizable time slot intervals ranging from 5 minutes to 4 hours to accommodate different appointment types across various healthcare specialties.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Different healthcare providers may require different appointment durations based on their specialty and services.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to search for properties based on specific criteria such as location, area, and number of bedrooms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search functionality must support all specified criteria (location, area, number of bedrooms) with 100% accuracy in matching results to the specified parameters.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The search must correctly implement all the specified criteria to fulfill its core purpose.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The property search must return results within 3 seconds for queries that may return up to 1000 properties, even during peak usage periods with 500 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick search response is essential for a good user experience in property search applications.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search function must utilize database indexing on all searchable fields to optimize query performance, with query execution plans that execute in under 1 second for 95% of searches.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource utilization is necessary to handle potentially complex property search queries.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search interface must provide autocomplete suggestions for location fields after the user types 3 or more characters, with suggestions appearing within 500ms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Autocomplete functionality improves usability by helping users specify locations correctly.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search results must be sortable by at least 5 different criteria (e.g., price, date listed, size) with clear visual indicators of the current sort order.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Sorting options are essential for users to organize property search results according to their preferences.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search functionality must maintain 99.95% uptime during business hours (8am-8pm local time), with degraded performance acceptable outside these hours only during scheduled maintenance.
identifiedNFRs.justification: High availability is crucial for property search functionality as it's a core feature of the system.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search function must sanitize all user inputs to prevent SQL injection attacks, with input validation for all search parameters before query execution.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Search functionality typically involves user input that must be secured against potential injection attacks.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search algorithm must be implemented in a separate service layer with documented APIs, allowing for future modifications to search logic without affecting the user interface.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Separating search logic improves maintainability as search algorithms may need optimization or enhancement over time.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search functionality must support the addition of new search criteria without requiring more than 8 hours of development effort per new criterion.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The system should be adaptable to include additional property search criteria as business needs evolve.

functionalRequirement: System shall calculate modification charges based on modifying time, date, route, availability, display new fares, and process payments through the payment gateway.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must correctly calculate modification charges with 100% accuracy for all combinations of time, date, route, and availability changes according to the defined business rules.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires precise calculation of charges based on multiple variables, necessitating complete functional correctness.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must calculate modification charges and display new fares within 2 seconds of receiving all required inputs, even during peak loads of 1000 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick calculation and display of fares is essential for a smooth user experience when making modifications.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Payment processing through the payment gateway must complete within 5 seconds for 95% of transactions and within 10 seconds for 99.5% of transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR includes payment processing which requires efficient time behavior to maintain user satisfaction.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must display new fares in a format that clearly differentiates between original fare, modification charges, and total amount due, with appropriate currency symbols and decimal places.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Clear presentation of fare information is crucial for users to understand the financial impact of their modifications.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must maintain 99.9% uptime for the modification and payment processing functions, with scheduled maintenance occurring only during off-peak hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves financial transactions that require high availability to ensure users can make modifications when needed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All payment data must be encrypted using TLS 1.3 or higher during transmission and must comply with PCI DSS requirements for storage and processing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR includes payment processing which requires strong security measures to protect sensitive financial information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must maintain an audit log of all modification charges and payment transactions, recording user ID, timestamp, modification details, and transaction ID for a minimum of 3 years.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Financial transactions require accountability and traceability for both business and regulatory purposes.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The fare calculation module must be implemented as a separate component with well-defined interfaces, allowing for modification of pricing rules without affecting other system components.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The complexity of fare calculations based on multiple variables requires a modular approach for easier maintenance and updates.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support integration with at least 3 different payment gateways, with the ability to add new payment gateways without modifying the core payment processing logic.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Payment processing through gateways requires flexibility to adapt to different providers and future changes.

functionalRequirement: The system shall generate a PDF report of all transactions and send a copy to the customer's email address and another copy to the system database for monthly transaction calculation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The PDF report must include all transaction details including date, time, transaction ID, amount, payment method, and item details with 100% accuracy and completeness.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive transaction reporting with no missing information to ensure functional completeness.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must generate the PDF report and send it to both the customer's email and the database within 30 seconds of transaction completion.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Timely generation and delivery of transaction reports is necessary for good user experience and operational efficiency.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The PDF generation process must consume no more than 100MB of memory per report, regardless of the number of transactions included.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource utilization is important for scalability, especially when generating reports with many transactions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The PDF report must be formatted with a clear hierarchical structure, consistent font sizes (minimum 11pt), appropriate spacing, and must be accessible according to PDF/UA standards.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The report needs to be easily readable and accessible to all users, including those with disabilities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must successfully deliver email reports to customers for at least 99% of all transactions, with automatic retry mechanisms for failed deliveries (3 attempts at 10-minute intervals).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Reliable delivery of transaction reports is essential as they serve as receipts and records for customers.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All PDF reports must be digitally signed to ensure authenticity and must be encrypted with AES-256 when stored in the database and when transmitted via email.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Transaction reports contain sensitive financial information requiring protection and verification of authenticity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Customer email addresses must be validated before sending reports and must be stored in the database using appropriate encryption or hashing techniques in compliance with data protection regulations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Email addresses are personal data requiring protection, and validation prevents delivery errors.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The PDF report template must be configurable through external files or database settings, allowing for changes to report format, branding, and content without requiring code modifications.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Report formats often need updates for branding or content changes, requiring easy maintainability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support multiple email service providers with automatic failover capability if the primary email service is unavailable.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Email delivery is critical to the FR, requiring adaptability to ensure successful delivery under various conditions.
